title: Apple is officially a $1 trillion company - here are 32 photos of how it came to rule the world (AAPL)
text: Apple is officially a $1 trillion company — here are 32 photos of how it came to rule the world (AAPL) By Matt Weinberger Aug 2, 2018, 12:22 pm 6 pts It's official: Apple has become the first $1 trillion company in history. The milestone is even more significant when you consider that Apple almost didn't even get the chance to make it this far. When Steve Jobs took over as CEO of Apple in 1997, the company had been struggling to find its legs…
